verdict.rationale: Cognee documents an ontology mechanism—an optional RDF/OWL file that maps extracted entity types and mentions to canonical domain concepts—which lets an ML engineer customize entity typing to their domain (docs-8, docs-20, docs-35, docs-39). However there is no evidence of first-class support for defining custom edge/relation types or otherwise editing the graph schema beyond ontology-based entity mapping. Missing for 10: documented support for custom edge/relation types, explicit schema/graph-model customization API, and independent/hands-on confirmation that ontology customization actually reshapes the graph in practice.
